newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers head higher but buyers still reluctant.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers head higher but buyers still reluctant.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices edged higher on Thursday following the barge market's strength, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers were quoted at around $85/$87 fob after the barge market first surged to $87 then withdrew to $85. The bunker market had another day of thin activity as buyers appeared to have little faith in the dramatic rise.
The desire to conclude some business before the day was out persuaded some to sell at levels no higher than barge prices.
"The suppliers were complaining like crazy. Some of them were desperate for business," one supplier said.
Hamburg 380 CST fuel oil dropped to narrow the differential above Rotterdam prices which encouraged some buyers towards the end of the day.
Mediterranean prices were broadly steady and activity in most ports was slight. Just a few suppliers found reasonable enquiries with some shipowners expecting prices to firm.
Fujairah prices started softer as Singapore came off, but rose in the afternoon, killing many enquiries.
